2	 * PTY socket adopter — speaks the bg-pty-host wire protocol.
3	 *
4	 * Daemon-less ccb's `ccb attach <short>` opens this directly against
5	 * the PTY host's socket; a future Phase C+ daemon would also use it
6	 * for cross-process supervision. Mirrors ant 4704.js rj6, but trimmed
7	 * down: ccb has no daemon supervisor so the respawn-detection /
8	 * upgrade-tracking / roster-hooks branches are removed. What's kept:
9	 *
10	 *   - Connect with backoff (WXK=30 attempts, PXK=[100,250,500,1000,2000])
11	 *   - ENOENT detection (socket file gone) → caller-visible error
12	 *   - Hello-handshake receipt (capture replPid + version)
13	 *   - Buffer queue while disconnected (cap 2MB before drop)
14	 *   - Per-client backpressure: writableLength > 1 MiB → destroy
15	 *   - onData / onExit pub-sub callbacks
16	 *   - write / resize / kill / dispose API surface
17	 *   - SIGKILL escalation 5s after SIGTERM
18	 *
19	 * @dynamicRequire
20	 */

22	import { type Socket, connect } from 'node:net'
23	
24	import {
25	  CTRL_TAG,
26	  DATA_TAG,
27	  type CtrlFrame,
28	  createFrameDecoder,
29	  encodeCtrlFrame,
30	  encodeDataFrame,
31	  FRAME_SIZE_CAP,
32	} from './ptyFrame.js'
33	
34	const RECONNECT_BACKOFF_MS = [100, 250, 500, 1000, 2000] as const
35	const MAX_RECONNECT_ATTEMPTS = 30
36	const QUEUE_CAP_BYTES = 2 * FRAME_SIZE_CAP // 2 * qiH = 2 MiB
37	const CLIENT_BACKPRESSURE_BYTES = 1024 * 1024
38	const SIGTERM_GRACE_MS = 5000

40	export interface PtyAdopter {
41	  /** Currently-known REPL pid (from hello frame). 0 if not yet seen. */
42	  replPid(): number
43	  /** Currently-known REPL version (from hello frame). '' if not yet seen. */
44	  replVersion(): string
45	  /** Send raw bytes to the PTY (will be decoded as user input). Takes a
46	   *  Buffer, NOT a string: stdin bytes (esp. multi-byte UTF-8 like CJK) must
47	   *  pass through verbatim. A string round-trip (toString('binary') at the
48	   *  caller + Buffer.from(s,'utf8') here) double-encoded high bytes and
49	   *  corrupted CJK input. */
50	  write(b: Buffer): void
51	  /** Send a resize ctrl frame. */
52	  resize(cols: number, rows: number): void
53	  /** Send a kill ctrl frame. SIGTERM auto-escalates to SIGKILL after 5s. */
54	  kill(sig: 'SIGTERM' | 'SIGKILL'): void
55	  /** Tear down the adopter (closes socket, cancels timers). */
56	  dispose(): void
57	  /** Subscribe to PTY output (bytes from the host). */
58	  onData(cb: (chunk: Buffer) => void): { dispose: () => void }
59	  /** Subscribe to host exit notification. */
60	  onExit(
61	    cb: (info: { exitCode: number; signal?: string }) => void,
62	  ): { dispose: () => void }
63	  /** Subscribe to host heartbeat ctrl-frames (every 5s while alive). */

65	}

67	interface AdopterEvent<T> {
68	  emit(value: T): void
69	  subscribe(cb: (value: T) => void): () => void
70	}

72	function makeEvent<T>(): AdopterEvent<T> {
73	  const subs = new Set<(value: T) => void>()
74	  return {
75	    emit(value: T): void {
76	      for (const cb of subs) cb(value)
77	    },
78	    subscribe(cb: (value: T) => void): () => void {
79	      subs.add(cb)
80	      return () => subs.delete(cb)
81	    },
82	  }
83	}

85	/**
86	 * Open an adopter against the PTY socket at `socketPath`. Returns
87	 * immediately; the connection happens asynchronously and any data
88	 * sent via `write/resize/kill` before connect completes is queued.
89	 */
90	export function createPtyAdopter(socketPath: string): PtyAdopter {
91	  const onDataEvent = makeEvent<Buffer>()
92	  const onExitEvent = makeEvent<{ exitCode: number; signal?: string }>()
93	  const onHeartbeatEvent = makeEvent<{ ts: number; state?: string }>()
94	
95	  let socket: Socket | undefined
96	  let pendingFrames: Buffer[] = []
97	  let pendingBytes = 0
98	  let connected = false
99	  let disposed = false
100	  let attempt = 0
101	  let reconnectTimer: NodeJS.Timeout | undefined
102	  let drainTimer: NodeJS.Timeout | undefined
103	  let backpressureTimer: NodeJS.Timeout | undefined
104	  let sigkillTimer: NodeJS.Timeout | undefined
105	  let helloPid = 0
106	  let helloVersion = ''

108	  function clearTimers(): void {
109	    if (drainTimer) {
110	      clearTimeout(drainTimer)

112	    }
113	    if (backpressureTimer) {
114	      clearTimeout(backpressureTimer)
115	      backpressureTimer = undefined
116	    }
117	  }
118	
119	  function notifyExit(exitCode: number, signal?: string): void {
120	    if (disposed) return
121	    disposed = true
122	    if (sigkillTimer) {
123	      clearTimeout(sigkillTimer)
124	      sigkillTimer = undefined
125	    }
126	    clearTimers()
127	    socket?.destroy()
128	    socket = undefined
129	    onExitEvent.emit({ exitCode, signal })
130	  }
131	
132	  function enqueueOrSend(frame: Buffer): void {
133	    if (socket && !socket.destroyed) {
134	      const ok = socket.write(frame)
135	      if (!ok) {
136	        // backpressure — schedule destroy if drain doesn't fire in 10s
137	        // (ant XW3 = 10000), and immediate destroy if the buffer crosses
138	        // CLIENT_BACKPRESSURE_BYTES (ant GXK).
139	        if (!drainTimer) {
140	          drainTimer = setTimeout(() => {
141	            drainTimer = undefined
142	            socket?.destroy()
143	          }, 10_000)
144	          drainTimer.unref()
145	        }
146	        if (
147	          !backpressureTimer &&
148	          socket.writableLength > CLIENT_BACKPRESSURE_BYTES
149	        ) {
150	          backpressureTimer = setTimeout(() => {
151	            backpressureTimer = undefined
152	            if (
153	              socket &&
154	              !socket.destroyed &&
155	              socket.writableLength > CLIENT_BACKPRESSURE_BYTES
156	            ) {
157	              clearTimers()
158	              socket.destroy()
159	            }
160	          }, 50) // ant PW3 = 50ms grace
161	          backpressureTimer.unref()
162	        }
163	      }
164	      return
165	    }
166	    // Not connected — queue. Drop oldest if over cap.
167	    if (pendingBytes + frame.length > QUEUE_CAP_BYTES) return
168	    pendingFrames.push(frame)
169	    pendingBytes += frame.length
170	  }
171	
172	  function handleFrame(frame: { kind: number; payload?: Buffer; ctrl?: CtrlFrame }): void {
173	    if (frame.kind === DATA_TAG && frame.payload) {
174	      onDataEvent.emit(frame.payload)
175	    } else if (frame.kind === CTRL_TAG && frame.ctrl) {
176	      const c = frame.ctrl
177	      if (c.t === 'hello') {
178	        helloPid = c.replPid
179	        helloVersion = c.version
180	      } else if (c.t === 'live') {
181	        // No-op; live just signals that ring buffer replay is done.
182	      } else if (c.t === 'exit') {
183	        notifyExit(c.code, c.signal)
184	      } else if (c.t === 'heartbeat') {
185	        onHeartbeatEvent.emit({ ts: c.ts, state: c.state })
186	      }
187	    }
188	  }
189	
190	  function tryConnect(): void {
191	    if (disposed || connected) return
192	    const sock = connect(socketPath)
193	    let opened = false
194	    sock.on('error', err => {
195	      if ((err as NodeJS.ErrnoException).code === 'ENOENT') {
196	        // Socket file is gone — host died or never started.
197	        // Bubble up as exit so the caller can give up. ant 4704.js:95
198	        // would retry here; daemon-less ccb has no host to wait for.
199	        if (!opened) notifyExit(-1, 'ENOENT')
200	      }
201	      sock.destroy()
202	    })
203	    sock.once('close', () => {
204	      if (socket === sock) {
205	        socket = undefined
206	        connected = false
207	        clearTimers()
208	      }
209	      if (!disposed && !opened) {
210	        // Connection failed before opening — schedule retry.
211	        scheduleReconnect()
212	      }
213	    })
214	    sock.once('connect', () => {
215	      opened = true
216	      connected = true
217	      attempt = 0
218	      socket = sock
219	      sock.on('drain', clearTimers)
220	      // Flush queued frames.
221	      const queued = pendingFrames
222	      pendingFrames = []
223	      pendingBytes = 0
224	      for (const f of queued) enqueueOrSend(f)
225	    })
226	    const decoder = createFrameDecoder(handleFrame, () => sock.destroy())
227	    sock.on('data', decoder)
228	  }
229	
230	  function scheduleReconnect(): void {
231	    if (disposed || reconnectTimer) return
232	    if (attempt >= MAX_RECONNECT_ATTEMPTS) {
233	      notifyExit(-1, 'reconnect-exhausted')
234	      return
235	    }
236	    const delay =
237	      RECONNECT_BACKOFF_MS[Math.min(attempt, RECONNECT_BACKOFF_MS.length - 1)]!
238	    attempt++
239	    reconnectTimer = setTimeout(() => {
240	      reconnectTimer = undefined
241	      tryConnect()
242	    }, delay)
243	    reconnectTimer.unref()
244	  }
245	
246	  // Kick off the initial connection.
247	  tryConnect()
248	
249	  return {
250	    replPid: () => helloPid,
251	    replVersion: () => helloVersion,
252	    write(buf: Buffer): void {
253	      if (disposed) return
254	      // Frame body cap is 1 MiB; chunk if larger.
255	      const chunkSize = FRAME_SIZE_CAP - 1
256	      for (let i = 0; i < buf.length; i += chunkSize) {
257	        enqueueOrSend(encodeDataFrame(buf.subarray(i, i + chunkSize)))
258	      }
259	    },
260	    resize(cols: number, rows: number): void {
261	      if (disposed) return
262	      enqueueOrSend(encodeCtrlFrame({ t: 'resize', cols, rows }))
263	    },
264	    kill(sig: 'SIGTERM' | 'SIGKILL'): void {
265	      if (disposed) return
266	      enqueueOrSend(encodeCtrlFrame({ t: 'kill', sig }))
267	      if (sig === 'SIGTERM') {
268	        if (sigkillTimer) clearTimeout(sigkillTimer)
269	        sigkillTimer = setTimeout(() => {
270	          sigkillTimer = undefined
271	          if (!disposed) {
272	            enqueueOrSend(encodeCtrlFrame({ t: 'kill', sig: 'SIGKILL' }))
273	          }
274	        }, SIGTERM_GRACE_MS)
275	        sigkillTimer.unref()
276	      }
277	    },
278	    dispose(): void {
279	      if (disposed) return
280	      disposed = true
281	      if (reconnectTimer) {
282	        clearTimeout(reconnectTimer)
283	        reconnectTimer = undefined
284	      }
285	      if (sigkillTimer) {
286	        clearTimeout(sigkillTimer)
287	        sigkillTimer = undefined
288	      }
289	      clearTimers()
290	      socket?.destroy()
291	      socket = undefined
292	    },
293	    onData(cb): { dispose: () => void } {
294	      const off = onDataEvent.subscribe(cb)
295	      return { dispose: off }
296	    },
297	    onExit(cb): { dispose: () => void } {
298	      const off = onExitEvent.subscribe(cb)
299	      return { dispose: off }
300	    },
301	    onHeartbeat(cb): { dispose: () => void } {
302	      const off = onHeartbeatEvent.subscribe(cb)
303	      return { dispose: off }
304	    },
305	  }
306	}

255	  // the freshly persisted intent), `$` is the classifier source, `C` is
256	  // the user prompt (state.intent), and `S` is the agent's first text
257	  // message tail (we approximate with the ring tail used by classify).
258	  //
259	  // The namer is fire-once per worker lifetime (via attempted Set in
260	  // namer.ts), so spamming this branch is safe — it self-debounces.
261	  if (result.source === 'llm') {
262	    const jobsRoot = join(getConfigHomeDir(), 'jobs', state.vm.short)
263	    const fleetState = await readJobState(jobsRoot).catch(() => null)
264	    const intent =
265	      fleetState?.intent ?? state.intent ?? fleetState?.initialPrompt
266	    if (
267	      fleetState !== null &&
268	      (fleetState.name === undefined || fleetState.name === '') &&
269	      typeof intent === 'string' &&
270	      intent.length > 0
271	    ) {
272	      void generateJobName({
273	        short: state.vm.short,
274	        userMsg: intent,
275	        // Use the LLM detail as a compact agent-tail proxy — full text
276	        // would blow past Vq3's 300-char cap and ant truncates anyway.
277	        agentTail: result.detail ?? '',
278	      }).catch(() => undefined)
279	    }
280	  }
